title: pkg/testutils: Implement DiffTest harness (prd001 R1-R5)
description:
deliverable_type: code

required_reading:
  - docs/specs/product-requirements/prd001-testutils.yaml (full PRD for pkg/testutils -- defines DiffTest struct, binary execution, comparison, normalization, and file-state requirements)
  - docs/ARCHITECTURE.yaml (component descriptions for pkg/testutils, project structure, technology choices)
  - go.mod (Go module path: github.com/petar-djukic/go-unix-utils)

files:
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest.go
    action: create
    note: DiffTest struct, Normalize type, RunDiffTests function, binary execution and comparison logic
  - path: pkg/testutils/normalizers.go
    action: create
    note: TimestampNormalizer and ComposeNormalizers helper
  - path: pkg/testutils/difftest_test.go
    action: create
    note: Unit tests for RunDiffTests, comparison, normalization, timeout, and file-state comparison

requirements:
  - id: R1
    text: |
      Define DiffTest struct and Normalize function type per prd001-testutils R1 (R1.1-R1.4).
      DiffTest fields: Name string (used as subtest name), Args []string (command-line args
      passed to both binaries), Stdin []byte (nil means no stdin input -- EOF immediately),
      Env []string (nil means inherit test process environment), ExitCode int (expected exit
      code -- used only for documentation; actual comparison is between the two binaries),
      Normalize []Normalize (slice of normalization functions applied in order; nil means no
      normalization), WorkDir string (working directory for both binaries; empty means create
      a per-test temporary directory), ExpectedFiles map[string][]byte (expected file content
      after execution; nil means no file comparison). Define Normalize as func([]byte) []byte.
  - id: R2
    text: |
      Implement binary execution per prd001-testutils R2 (R2.1-R2.5). Provide
      RunDiffTests(t *testing.T, goBinary string, refBinary string, tests []DiffTest) as the
      primary API. For each DiffTest, execute goBinary and refBinary with identical Args,
      Stdin, and Env. Capture stdout, stderr, and exit code independently from each binary.
      Impose a configurable timeout (default 10 seconds) on each invocation using
      os/exec.CommandContext with context.WithTimeout. When WorkDir is empty, create a
      per-test temporary directory via t.TempDir(). When WorkDir is set, use it as the
      working directory for both binaries. Produce no output to the test process stdout or
      stderr during a passing test run.
  - id: R3
    text: |
      Implement comparison and divergence reporting per prd001-testutils R3 (R3.1-R3.6).
      Apply each Normalize function in the DiffTest.Normalize slice (in order) to both
      binaries' stdout and stderr before comparison. Compare normalized stdout byte-for-byte;
      any difference is a test failure. Compare normalized stderr byte-for-byte; any
      difference is a test failure. Compare exit codes exactly; a difference is a test
      failure. On divergence, report in the failure message: the DiffTest Args, the Stdin
      content (truncated to 256 bytes if longer), the reference binary stdout, the Go binary
      stdout, the reference stderr, the Go stderr, and both exit codes. Run each DiffTest as
      a named subtest via t.Run(test.Name, ...) so individual test case failures are
      identifiable in go test output.
  - id: R4
    text: |
      Implement normalization hooks per prd001-testutils R4 (R4.1-R4.3). Support per-DiffTest
      normalization via the Normalize slice field. Provide a built-in TimestampNormalizer
      (a Normalize function) that replaces common strftime timestamp patterns with the fixed
      placeholder string "TIMESTAMP". Patterns to match: syslog format ("Feb 19 12:34:56" --
      three-letter month, space-padded day, HH:MM:SS), ISO-8601 datetime
      ("2024-02-19T12:34:56" with optional fractional seconds and timezone), and HH:MM:SS
      elapsed time ("00:05:32"). Use regexp.ReplaceAll for pattern matching. Provide a
      ComposeNormalizers(funcs ...Normalize) Normalize helper that returns a single Normalize
      function applying each input function in order. When the input slice is empty, the
      composed function returns its input unchanged.
  - id: R5
    text: |
      Implement file-state comparison per prd001-testutils R5 (R5.1-R5.2). When
      DiffTest.ExpectedFiles is non-nil, after both binaries exit, read each file path key
      from the Go binary's working directory and compare its content byte-for-byte against the
      expected []byte value. Report file content divergence in the same format as stdout
      divergence, including the file path, expected content, and actual content.

design_decisions:
  - id: D1
    text: |
      Primary source file is difftest.go, named after the primary exported type DiffTest.
      The package file must not be named testutils.go (project convention: file named after
      primary exported type, not after the package).
  - id: D2
    text: |
      Use os/exec.CommandContext with context.WithTimeout for binary invocation. Extract exit
      code from exec.ExitError.ExitCode() on error; exit code 0 when err is nil. This avoids
      platform-specific syscall.WaitStatus extraction.
  - id: D3
    text: |
      RunDiffTests calls t.Run(test.Name, func(t *testing.T) {...}) for each DiffTest to
      produce named subtests per prd001-testutils R3.6. Each subtest is independent and can
      be run individually via go test -run.
  - id: D4
    text: |
      Normalizers live in a separate file (normalizers.go) to keep the primary difftest.go
      focused on execution and comparison. TimestampNormalizer uses compiled regexp patterns
      (package-level var via regexp.MustCompile) for performance.

acceptance_criteria:
  - id: AC1
    text: |
      A cmd/ package can define a []DiffTest slice and call
      RunDiffTests(t, goBinary, refBinary, tests) from a TestXxx function with no other
      setup. The function signature matches this exactly.
  - id: AC2
    text: |
      A passing test run produces no output to stdout or stderr. A failing test prints the
      triggering Args, Stdin (truncated to 256 bytes), both binaries' stdout, stderr, and
      exit codes in the failure message via t.Errorf or t.Fatalf.
  - id: AC3
    text: |
      TimestampNormalizer replaces "Feb 19 12:34:56"-style timestamps, ISO-8601 datetime
      strings, and HH:MM:SS elapsed strings with the placeholder "TIMESTAMP". Verified by
      unit test in difftest_test.go.
  - id: AC4
    text: |
      A DiffTest with ExpectedFiles correctly fails when the Go binary writes different
      content than expected. Verified by unit test.
  - id: AC5
    text: |
      A DiffTest that exceeds the 10-second timeout fails with a clear timeout message
      rather than hanging the test run. Verified by unit test using a short timeout override.
  - id: AC6
    text: |
      All pkg/testutils code compiles with no warnings under golangci-lint. Verify by running
      golangci-lint run ./pkg/testutils/... with no output.
  - id: AC7
    text: |
      Unit tests in difftest_test.go pass via go test ./pkg/testutils/... and cover:
      identical binary outputs (pass), divergent stdout (fail), divergent stderr (fail),
      divergent exit code (fail), TimestampNormalizer replacement, ComposeNormalizers
      chaining, and timeout expiration.
